issues.issue: Does 'granted a stay under the former Act' in IRPA s.196 include the automatic stay that arose on filing an appeal under IA para 49(1)(b)?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says 'granted a stay' means only IAD stays under IA 73(1)(c), so Medovarski's appeal was properly discontinued.
issues.respondent_position: Medovarski says the stay arising on filing her appeal counts, so her appeal continues under the former Act.
issues.result_quote: section 196 discontinues appeals only when a stay has been granted on the disposition of an appeal under IA, paragraph 73(1)(c)

issues.issue: Does discontinuing the appeal under s.196 breach s.7 of the Charter?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says there is no fundamental justice breach: no misleading conduct, no legitimate expectation, and risk and H&C reviews remain.
issues.respondent_position: Medovarski says removal without an appeal breaches s.7, since she was misled and may be removed before an H&C decision.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that it would be a breach of section 7 to apply section 196 to Ms. Medovarski
